gamification.title: Donx coins
gamification.hello: Welcome to Donx: buy, sell and collect coins!
gamification.intro: Donx is not like ordinary classifieds. Browsing and posting listings is free. Coins are only for unlocking a contact and for boosting, and you earn them by being active.
gamification.s1Text: Unlocking one contact costs 1 🪙, so that covers 50 contacts.
gamification.s2Text:
+1 🪙 for every new listing (up to 3 a day)
+5 🪙 when you mark a listing as done (up to 2 a day)
Plus the daily wheel: 1 to 15 🪙
gamification.s3Text: For 5 🪙 your listing jumps to the top of the board for 24 hours.
